answer: An agent identity is bonded to skin in the game rather than a free keypair: a newcomer must stake collateral and be vouched by peers who already carry stake, and slashing burns that stake plus part of the voucher's. A sybil farm cannot mint a thousand cheap identities, since every puppet needs its own capital and reputation before it can earn. The quill that signs a peer attestation is matched to real value, and a counterfeit marble of endorsements costs the attacker the full stake per fake node. Building a large atlas of colluders is ruinously expensive, so honesty stays cheaper.
